document_api_meta.title: Submit Size Chart Appeal
document_api_meta.env_desc:
#### Appeal Size Chart Verification
Initiates an appeal process for a product that was blocked during the listing phase due to a size chart verification failure.
This API is used when a seller believes their product was incorrectly blocked by our automated size chart validation system. The validation checks for three potential issues:
1. Whether the size chart contains all mandatory dimensions.
2. Whether the size chart covers all Stock-Keeping Units (SKUs) for sale.
3. Whether the numerical values within the size chart are valid.
If the validation system detects an issue, the product listing will be blocked. By using this API, sellers can submit an appeal. If the appeal is approved, the block will be lifted, and the seller can re-list the product.
Use the `[Appeal Status Webhook]` to monitor the appeal's progress, or pass the `appeal_id` to the `[Get Appeal Status API]` to retrieve the current status.
Note:
- Please wait at least 5 minutes after submitting an appeal before checking its status via the API to ensure the data is synchronized.
- You can submit up to 50 appeals per day. Any requests exceeding this limit will be rejected.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

request_body_param.name: appeal_message
request_body_param.desc: Details of the products submitted for appeal

request_body_param.name: ^field_name
request_body_param.desc:
The target fields to appeal.
Possible values:
- APPEAL_MESSAGE_FIELD_SIZE_CHART

request_body_param.name: ^indicator_details
request_body_param.desc: Indicator details of the products submitted for appeal

request_body_param.name: ^^indicator_type
request_body_param.desc:
The target indicator_type to appeal of this field.
Possible values:
- REQUIRED_DIMENSION：Does the size chart include all required dimensions?
- CONTAINS_ALL_SALE_PROPERTY：Does the size chart cover all sales attributes?""
- VALUE_RANGE_OUT_OF_RANGE：Are the value ranges in the size chart valid?

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

// For more details about the SDK, refer to the documentation:
// https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/67c83e0799a75104986ae498
func product202604SubmitSizeChartAppealPost() {
    configuration := apis.NewConfiguration()
    configuration.AddAppInfo(appKey, appSecret)
    apiClient := apis.NewAPIClient(configuration)
    request := apiClient.ProductV202604API.Product202604AppealsSubmitPost(context.Background())
    request = request.XTtsAccessToken("your access token")
    request = request.ContentType("application/json")
    request = request.ShopCipher("your shop cipher")
    product202604SubmitSizeChartAppealRequestBody := product_v202604.NewProduct202604SubmitSizeChartAppealRequestBody()
    product202604SubmitSizeChartAppealRequestBody.SetProductId(1729532326804361713)
    product202604SubmitSizeChartAppealRequestBodyAppealMessage := product_v202604.NewProduct202604SubmitSizeChartAppealRequestBodyAppealMessage()
    product202604SubmitSizeChartAppealRequestBodyAppealMessage.SetFieldName("APPEAL_MESSAGE_FIELD_SIZE_CHART")
    product202604SubmitSizeChartAppealRequestBodyAppealMessageIndicatorDetails := product_v202604.NewProduct202604SubmitSizeChartAppealRequestBodyAppealMessageIndicatorDetails()
    product202604SubmitSizeChartAppealRequestBodyAppealMessageIndicatorDetails.SetIndicatorType("CONTAINS_ALL_SALE_PROPERTY")
    product202604SubmitSizeChartAppealRequestBodyAppealMessageIndicatorDetailsList := []product_v202604.Product202604SubmitSizeChartAppealRequestBodyAppealMessageIndicatorDetails{*product202604SubmitSizeChartAppealRequestBodyAppealMessageIndicatorDetails}
    product202604SubmitSizeChartAppealRequestBodyAppealMessage.SetIndicatorDetails(product202604SubmitSizeChartAppealRequestBodyAppealMessageIndicatorDetailsList)
    product202604SubmitSizeChartAppealRequestBodyAppealMessage.SetSizeChartId("7597302357391361806")
    product202604SubmitSizeChartAppealRequestBodyAppealMessage.SetSizeChartImageUri("tos-alisg-i-aphluv4xwc-sg/ebf6d1b2204a4aa883abb0befb6fee50")
    product202604SubmitSizeChartAppealRequestBody.SetAppealMessage(*product202604SubmitSizeChartAppealRequestBodyAppealMessage)
    request = request.Product202604SubmitSizeChartAppealRequestBody(*product202604SubmitSizeChartAppealRequestBody)
    resp, httpResp, err := request.Execute()
    if err != nil || httpResp.StatusCode != 200 {
        fmt.Printf("productsRequest err:%v resbody:%s", err, httpResp.Body)
        return
    }
    if resp == nil {
        fmt.Printf("response is nil")
        return
    }
    if resp.GetCode()!= 0 {
        fmt.Printf("response business is error, errorCode:%d errorMessage:%s", resp.GetCode(), resp.GetMessage())
        return
    }
    respDataJson, _ := json.MarshalIndent(resp.GetData(), "", "  ")
    fmt.Println("response data:", string(respDataJson))
    return
}
